statement: The reusable A0 word implementation supplies modular construction, unsigned and signed readings, little-endian byte split and join, zero extension, sign extension, truncation, and explicit invalid-direction errors across all supported widths.
scope: Complete enumeration of every 8- and 16-bit source word across every legal widening target, plus five boundary vectors at each supported width from 24 through 64; 65,822 source words and 2,106,910 operation checks.
exclusions: Exhaustive enumeration of the complete 24- through 64-bit value domains
An induction theorem over arbitrary widths
A proof of the Rust compiler or the independent integer oracle

negative_control.mutates: Implement zero extension by repeating the source sign bit

limitations: Exhaustiveness covers only the complete width-8 and width-16 value domains; larger widths use named boundary vectors.
The checker and semantic implementation share one Axeyum repository, although the operation expectations are recomputed with independent integer formulas.
